subject: Security review kickoff — HealthSync
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security review kickoff — HealthSync

Hi Alyssa,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the security intake moving.

Summary from call:
- Objective: complete security review + scope so we can proceed to a pilot with Redwood in November.
- Primary concerns: data classification, SSO integration, AWS accounts, and deployment (cloud vs on-prem).

Open questions / items we need from you:
1) Can you share an initial list of systems and environments that should be in scope (app URLs, AWS account IDs, DB types, on-prem systems)?
2) Please confirm whether PHI/ePHI or other regulated data will be in scope.
3) Who is the economic buyer and what is procurement timeline (Ben Cho / procurement@healthsync.com? Confirm please).

Attached is our high-level security questionnaire to speed intake: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf. Filling the questionnaire and/or sharing a system inventory will help Marissa and our security team scope the review faster.

Next step suggestion: schedule a 30-45 min security kickoff next week with your security and procurement leads + our security/SE team. I can send a couple of times if that works.

Thanks — feel free to loop in anyone else who should be on the kickoff.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_security_questionnaire_v1.pdf

From: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@healthsync.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Cho <ben.cho@healthsync.com>, procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff — HealthSync

Sean — thanks for the recap. Forwarding the initial inventory and confirming a few things on our side.

Answers:
- Economic buyer: Confirming Ben Cho (cc'd). Procurement timeline: Targeting contract signature by end of November; evaluation and security review need to finish by mid-November.
- Data: Our service processes patient appointment and clinical scheduling metadata; there is limited PHI in some payloads. I'll highlight which endpoints touch PHI in the inventory.
- Systems: Attached is our initial system inventory (HealthSync_System_Inventory.csv) with app names, AWS account IDs, and whether they are production or staging.

A few notes:
- We do have an on-prem PostgreSQL cluster used for legacy reporting — please confirm whether that should be included in scope.
- We use Okta for SSO (SAML) and will need details on SAML attributes required for provisioning.

Forwarding to Ben for procurement comments and timeline.

Thanks,
Alyssa Turner
Senior Product Manager
HealthSync

Attachments: HealthSync_System_Inventory.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff — HealthSync (internal)

Thanks Sean / Alyssa for the inventory — that helps. A couple of clarifying questions from the security team before we lock scope: 

1) Environments: Are we scoping only production, or prod + staging/dev? For pilot we normally scope production + any staging that mirrors prod. Please confirm.
2) On-prem DB: If the legacy Postgres cluster stores PHI or is in the data path to Redwood, we will need network diagrams and access details (scheduling/replication details).
3) SSO: We support SAML/Okta — we'll need the SAML metadata and the list of attributes you plan to send (email, groups, roles).
4) Data flow: Any point where HealthSync persists user-uploaded files or unstructured patient data should be flagged.

If Alyssa can flag rows in the inventory that contain PHI, that will speed things up. I can draft a short kickoff agenda and a minimal evidence list (SOC2 artifacts, network diagram request, IAM snapshot) to send before the kickoff.

I'll propose the following internal owners: Marissa (security lead), Vivek (solutions/infra questions), Rachel Kim (procurement coordination). Sean, can you confirm we'll include Rachel once procurement details are needed?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Cho <ben.cho@healthsync.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>, Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@healthsync.com>
Cc: procurement@healthsync.com
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff — HealthSync (procurement)

Sean / Alyssa — procurement here. A couple items from our side: 
- Standard timeline: security review complete + signed SOW needed for internal sign-off. We usually allow 2-3 weeks for legal review once SOW/terms are provided.
- We prefer to review a preview SOW and a redlineable contract early. Can Redwood provide a standard SOW and standard terms to start?
- For any data-handling with PHI, we require evidence of SOC2 Type II and encryption-at-rest details. Please include a contact for your compliance team.

Ben Cho
Head of Procurement
HealthSync
procurement@healthsync.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Turner <alyssa.turner@healthsync.com>, Ben Cho <ben.cho@healthsync.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security review kickoff — HealthSync — confirmed scope & next steps

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps below so we're all aligned.

Scope (confirmed):
- In scope for initial security review: Production environment (AWS accounts listed in the inventory) + any staging instances that mirror production.
- On-prem Postgres: In scope only if it persists PHI or sits in the data path to Redwood. Alyssa to flag rows in the inventory that touch PHI.
- Data types: Limited PHI in some endpoints — Alyssa will highlight in the CSV.

Deliverables Redwood will provide this week:
- Filled security questionnaire (turnaround 2 business days)
- Proposed kickoff agenda and evidence checklist (kickoff_meeting_agenda.pdf)
- Standard SOW + terms (preview) for procurement review
- Contact for compliance (Marissa Cole, marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com)

Action items / owners:
- Alyssa: flag PHI rows in HealthSync_System_Inventory.csv and share SAML metadata if possible (owner: Alyssa)
- Ben: confirm procurement review window and any internal required clauses (owner: Ben)
- Marissa: draft evidence list and send pre-kickoff checklist (owner: Marissa)
- Vivek / Sean: coordinate technical/deployment questions ahead of kickoff
- Rachel Kim (cc): I'll loop you in once SOW/terms are ready for procurement negotiation.

Scheduling: Alyssa suggested next-week kickoff. I proposed two times in the calendar invite: Tue 2026-10-13 10:00-10:45 PT or Wed 2026-10-14 14:00-14:45 PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=healthsync-sec-kickoff-20261006

Related links (drive folder with questionnaire + inventory): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1HealthSync-Security

If that all looks right I'll send the filled questionnaire and agenda by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kickoff_meeting_agenda.pdf
